invariants.name: PRIMARY_VIEW_ONLY_CONTAINS_SURFACED_OPPORTUNITIES
invariants.rule: Pre-triage or otherwise hidden working-set roles must not appear as surfaced opportunity recommendations.

invariants.name: NULL_DOES_NOT_BECOME_SUBSTANTIVE_DECISION
invariants.rule: Null, missing, stale, failed, or unprocessed state must not be rendered as NEEDS_DATA, RELEVANT, REJECT, MONITOR, TIER_1, TIER_2, or another substantive business outcome.

invariants.name: LABELS_MATCH_BACKING_STATE
invariants.rule: Every human-facing count, badge, funnel stage, and label must accurately describe the persisted state/query that backs it.

invariants.name: INCOMPLETE_PROCESSING_IS_NOT_ZERO_RESULT
invariants.rule: A zero result must not imply completed assessment when a material upstream or downstream backlog remains unprocessed.

invariants.name: STATE_TRANSITIONS_ARE_ORDERED_AND_IDEMPOTENT
invariants.rule: Downstream decisions require valid upstream state; retries and duplicate executions must not create duplicate or contradictory canonical decisions.

invariants.name: STALE_RUNNING_WORK_IS_RECOVERABLE
invariants.rule: Work items or model runs may not remain indefinitely RUNNING beyond their lease/timeout; stale work must be detected and safely requeued or terminated.

invariants.name: MODEL_CAPACITY_IS_GLOBALLY_COORDINATED
invariants.rule: All model-calling workers must obey shared per-model capacity/backpressure so concurrent workflows cannot independently exhaust the same provider rate budget.

invariants.name: DEGRADED_RUNTIME_FAILS_SAFE
invariants.rule: When discovery, triage, qualification, provenance, or model runtime is materially unhealthy, the cockpit must expose the degraded state and avoid misleading recommendation semantics.

invariants.name: SOURCE_COVERAGE_IS_NOT_SOURCE_HEALTH
invariants.rule: Healthy configured connectors do not constitute proof of broad-market coverage; coverage and health must remain distinct measures.

invariants.name: POSTING_PROVENANCE_REMAINS_REACHABLE
invariants.rule: Any displayed role with a known canonical or discovery URL must retain direct source access and provenance.

invariants.name: POSITIVE_AND_NEGATIVE_ASSERTIONS_REQUIRED
invariants.rule: Material changes must test both expected behavior and prohibited behavior, including known-bad semantic outcomes.

invariants.name: USER_VISIBLE_ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRES_DEPLOYED_VERIFICATION
invariants.rule: Unit tests or code existence cannot certify user-visible behavior; deployed behavior must be reconciled with canonical runtime state.

invariants.name: PRIOR_PASS_REMAINS_FALSIFIABLE
invariants.rule: New contradictory runtime or owner-review evidence automatically invalidates a prior PASS until repaired and reverified.

invariants.name: BROAD_DISCOVERY_DOES_NOT_CREATE_INTERNET_DUMP
invariants.rule: Increasing recall at discovery must not bypass screening or broaden the primary human view with unqualified roles.

invariants.name: CONTROL_PLANE_WRITES_ARE_AUTONOMOUS
invariants.rule: Routine repository/Supabase control-plane evidence writes within authorized scope are not outbound candidate communication and must not create user approval stops.
